operation: identify a derived C output boundary with another template's derived C input boundary
state_semantics: functions on simultaneous boundary assignments, not temporal states or evolution
port_selection: C vertices with no incoming edges are entries; C vertices with no outgoing edges are exits; require unique nonisolated entry and exit
admission: Both value restrictions must be explicit bijections to the common boundary, with matching field, value basis and evaluation context. No default identity map.
sewing_rule: Admit (i,j) exactly when rho_left(i)=rho_right(j). Retain that common value as the shared coordinate.
residual_policy: For arbitrary ambient packets retain both Rv and (I-ER)v. Restriction alone is lossless only on im(E).
excluded_claims: P/N/E incidence selects which boundary identification occurs
